fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects potentially suspicious child processes of "GoogleUpdate.exe"
fields.name: Potentially Suspicious GoogleUpdate Child Process
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\\GoogleUpdate.exe" and (not ((tgt.process.image.path contains "\\Google" or (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\setup.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "chrome_updater.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "chrome_installer.exe")) or not (tgt.process.image.path matches "\.*")))))
